{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}

[[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] sent trusted '''"troubleshooters"''' to a [[Trade Federation brokerage house]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], where they would contact a [[Sei Taria's contact|specific person]] and buy a [[packet of information]]. The operation failed because Taria's enemies discovered the mission thanks to a [[Unidentified corrupt functionary|corrupt functionary]] in [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] office, and killed the contact. They then sent [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to track the troubleshooters, using sensors that homed in on the metal they were going to use to pay the contact. The troubleshooters eventually returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the security leak was discovered.
